title: RAW UNREVIEWED: local luminary participant incorporation with opposite ar/aiin light roles
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Partial local C0 authoring over both complete f68r2 rings and the whole f89v1.13–20 unit: ok=MOON, oko=SUN; B|ar X describes light received by B from X, B|aiin X light sent by B to X. RF okar oko gives the Moon a receiving role; the written ok core in later okaiin gives the same hypothesized Moon a sending role. Known raw okaiin doublets require source-boundary inspection before any global viability claim; the old isolated label limits export beyond the declared ring/prose scope. No repair, semantic test or confirmed meaning.

whole_units.target: Complete f68r2.6 and f68r2.31 rings, full ZL/IT f89v1.13–20 paragraph and RF comparison window, all288 alternative-reader source groups
whole_units.RF_limit: RF has no explicit paragraph flags; RF prose consequences are conditional window demonstrations, not verified whole-paragraph derivations.

five_content_choices: oko names the physical Sun (C0), retaining its internal o; not an alias of ok.
LIGHTS(source,recipient) is a physical illumination relation, not heat, generic influence, modern photon accounting or a measured light quantity.
ar orients the incorporated named body as recipient: AR(B)(X)=LIGHTS(X,B).
aiin orients the incorporated named body as source: AIIN(B)(X)=LIGHTS(B,X).
fixed_scope_and_types: Only exact bases ok and oko are in the NamedLuminary lexicon. This is not a universal reading of bare aiin/ar or every word ending in those letters. Every proposed use of these two bases in the same construction keeps its assigned meaning.

AR takes a NamedLuminary and returns a function requiring one LightSource argument; AIIN takes a NamedLuminary and returns a function requiring one IlluminableEntity argument. Application returns a RelationSpec, not a Body and not an assertion of actuality.

The right argument is obligatory and is the immediate next entire written group, with no skip. It must belong to the same complete text unit: the same source-marked prose paragraph or the same complete local ring. Physical line crossing is allowed within that paragraph. No paragraph crossing, wrap around a ring end, picture-supplied argument or free implicit argument.

The unfamiliar right groups keep unknown denotations. Their proposed argument role is an assumption, not evidence that they name Moon, Earth, drug, observer or any actual object. dal is not equated with dalg.

q/ch wrappers are retained. Y explicitly selects an inner-application-before-wrapper production: q/ch( AIIN(B)(X) ), with unknown operators M_q/M_ch over RelationSpec. It does not assert the inner relation, erase the wrapper, or give q/ch a positive/negative meaning. This is an extra scoped construction, not inferred from GDT1051.

No result-to-body projection, function-to-body cast, repeated-operator idempotence or ellipsis is supplied. A verified separated doublet inside the licensed scope would expose the declared type conflict; aggregate adjacency alone does not certify separators or paragraph scope.

No opening constructor is assigned. okey, okeo and ekey remain distinct and unknown at every occurrence, including both lower-ring okey positions in ZL/RF. No whole-word gloss or silent majority normalization fills them.

historical_primary.witness: Hildegard, Liber divinorum operum I.2 §XXXII, complete electronic Latin passage, columns775/776–779 with next heading retained; cached from https://www.clerus.org/bibliaclerusonline/it/fnk.htm. P_SOURCE_REVIEW.md distinguishes the text from the separately dated13th-century Lucca1942 f9r image; no new image or medieval collation in Y.
historical_primary.mechanism: The Moon receives deficient light from the Sun and then illuminates lower things as its helper. The same Moon also tempers solar heat with cold humour; that is a different relation. Other planets support/moderate solar fire, so this source does not establish a modern wholly independent self-luminous Sun mechanism.
historical_primary.source_limit: Historical analogy, not an identified plaintext or instruction to map every §XXXII detail. No exact exemplar or scene alignment claimed; no modern reflection/energy-conservation mechanism imported.
